entries.title: Cape Serein
entries.subtitle: Greater Serein · Veyra
entries.summary: A coastal district of Greater Serein where research campuses meet black cliffs, marsh causeways and engineered shorelines.
entries.detail:
Cape Serein contains a working coastal community, observation grounds and the Continuance Institute campus. Its cliffs, tidal marshes, causeways and engineered shelves make weather, access and long-term maintenance ordinary civic concerns.

This article describes the current district and its public scientific setting, not classified historical research or old manuscript timelines.

entries.title: Continuance Institute
entries.subtitle: Scientific and engineering institution · Greater Serein
entries.summary: A research and engineering institution with a public Cape Serein presence, professional staff and responsibilities bounded by civic authority.
entries.detail:
The Continuance Institute is part of the mature scientific landscape of Veyra. Its public work includes research, engineering, standards and technical institutions. Its Cape Serein campus connects specialist work with the surrounding city-region.

Scientific capability does not grant sovereignty. Staff culture, accountability and the distinction between technical advice and legitimate public decisions define its current public role. Restricted historical programs are outside this reader edition.
entries.keywords: Continuance Cape Serein research engineering standards institution

entries.title: Deep Three
entries.subtitle: Lunar research station · Ione
entries.summary: A Veyran lunar research station on Ione, introduced as a historical scientific facility without restricted program details.
entries.detail:
Deep Three, also called Lunar Deep Station Three, is a research installation on Veyra's large moon, Ione. Low gravity, negligible atmosphere and difficult access shape the engineering and logistics of any lunar station.

The public record establishes its place and scientific character only. Hidden facilities, unpublished research programs and disputed historical links are deliberately not described.

entries.title: GRAINIT
entries.subtitle: Exploratory finite-resolution geometry
entries.summary: An exploratory finite-resolution and quasilocal geometry program, not a proven theory of quantum gravity.
entries.detail:
GRAINIT explores descriptions of geometry that account for meaningful resolution limits and quantities defined over bounded regions. It is an exploratory mathematical and physical research program; its hypotheses must be distinguished from established experimental findings.

Scientific proposals and fictional transport technologies are separate subjects. This overview does not assert that a speculative physical model establishes the mechanism of an in-world Road.
entries.keywords: mathematics geometry quantum gravity finite resolution quasilocal

entries.title: Greater Serein
entries.subtitle: Coastal city-region · Veyra
entries.summary: A dense Veyran coastal metropolis encompassing Cape Serein and several distinct working districts.
entries.detail:
Greater Serein is a coastal city-region made up of districts including Cape Serein, Westbank, Low Harrow, Southbank District and Old Meridian. Shore conditions and infrastructure connect these communities without making them identical.

Homes, transit, public institutions, environmental management and specialist engineering coexist here. The region offers a view of the connected-world civilization through everyday urban life.
